definition: relating to education, especially at a college or university

examples.en: She has a strong academic background.

definition: to happen or make something happen faster

examples.en: The car accelerated to overtake the truck.

definition: a way of pronouncing words characteristic of a particular country or region

examples.en: He speaks English with a French accent.

definition: to take something that someone offers

examples.en: I accept your apology.

definition: the right or opportunity to use or look at something

examples.en: Students have access to the library.

definition: able to be reached, entered, or used by people

examples.en: The building is accessible to wheelchair users.
examples.zh: 这栋楼可供轮椅使用者进入。

translation: adj. 可接近的；可理解的

definition: an extra part added to something to make it more useful or attractive

examples.en: She bought a scarf as a fashion accessory.
examples.zh: 她买了一条围巾作为时尚配饰。

definition: something bad that happens unexpectedly, causing damage or injury

examples.en: He was injured in a car accident.

definition: to provide someone with a room or place to stay
root: ac-（向）+ com-（共同）+ -mod（尺度）+ -ate → 使适配

examples.en: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
examples.zh: 这家酒店能容纳200位客人。

definition: to go somewhere with someone, especially to look after them
root: ac-（向）+ com-（共同）+ -pany（面包）→ 共食伴

examples.en: Children must be accompanied by an adult.

definition: to succeed in doing something, especially after trying hard
root: ac-（向）+ com-（完全）+ -pli（满）+ -ish → 完成

examples.en: She accomplished her goal of becoming a doctor.
examples.zh: 她实现了当医生的目标。

definition: a record of money received and spent; a written or spoken description

examples.en: He opened a bank account last week.
examples.zh: 他上周开了个银行账户。

definition: to gradually get more and more of something over time

examples.en: Snow accumulated on the road overnight.

definition: correct and exact in all details

examples.en: The clock keeps accurate time.

definition: to say that someone has done something wrong or illegal

examples.en: He was accused of theft.

definition: familiar with something through experience; used to

examples.en: She is accustomed to getting up early.

definition: to successfully complete something or get a good result

examples.en: He achieved his dream of becoming an actor.
examples.zh: 他实现了当演员的梦想。

definition: a chemical substance that reacts with metals; sour in taste

examples.en: Lemons contain citric acid.

definition: to accept or admit that something is true or exists

examples.en: She refused to acknowledge her mistake.

definition: to make someone familiar with something or someone

examples.en: Please acquaint yourself with the safety rules.

definition: someone you know but who is not a close friend

examples.en: He is just a business acquaintance.
examples.zh: 他只是个生意上的熟人。

definition: to get or gain something, often by effort or payment

examples.en: She acquired fluency in French during her stay.
examples.zh: 她在逗留期间掌握了流利的法语。

definition: from one side to the other of something

examples.en: She walked across the street.

definition: to do something; to take action

examples.en: We must act quickly to solve the problem.
examples.zh: 我们必须迅速行动解决问题。

translation: v. 行动 n. 行为

definition: the process of doing something; a thing that you do

examples.en: Actions speak louder than words.

definition: always busy doing things; involved in something

examples.en: She leads an active life.

definition: something that you do for fun or pleasure; a thing that you do

examples.en: Swimming is my favourite activity.
examples.zh: 游泳是我最喜欢的活动。

definition: someone whose job is acting in plays or films

examples.en: He is a famous Hollywood actor.
examples.zh: 他是著名的好莱坞男演员。

definition: real; existing in fact

examples.en: The actual cost was higher than expected.
